$comment: Single source of truth for GitHub release asset filenames and their signing status. Consumed by scripts/docs/check-site-claims.ts (download-link + 'signed' claim verification) and, going forward, the desktop build scripts. Update filenames HERE first. `signed` reflects whether the shipped artifact is actually code-signed/notarized today. The `production-` prefix is Electrobun 2's canonical build environment; `stable` survives only as an alias and no longer appears in emitted artifact names. macOS x64 is absent because Electrobun 2 publishes no macos-x64 core archive.
